:::{#cor-odds-multiplier}

#### Odds at one covariate pattern from the odds at another

The [odds](binary-outcome-associations.qmd#def-odds) at [covariate pattern](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/logistic-inference.html#def-covariate-pattern) $\vx$
are the odds at $\vxs$
times the [exponential](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-exponential-function) of $\diffvx \cdot \vb$:

$$\odds(\vx) = \odds(\vxs) \cdot \expf{\diffvx \cdot \vb}$${#eq-odds-multiplier}

The factor $\expf{\diffvx \cdot \vb}$ is the [odds multiplier](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/logistic-inference.html#def-odds-multiplier) of the change $\diffvx$.

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\odds(\vx)
&= \odds(\vxs) \cdot \frac{\odds(\vx)}{\odds(\vxs)}
&& \text{(multiply and divide by } \odds(\vxs) > 0 \text{)}
\\
&= \odds(\vxs) \cdot \ror(\vx,\vxs)
&& \text{(definition of the odds ratio, @eq-def-ror)}
\\
&= \odds(\vxs) \cdot \expf{\diffvx \cdot \vb}
&& \text{(@thm-logistic-OR)}
\ea
$$

:::
